summary: Describes common practice for how nodes should behave when originating and receiving RSVP-TE Path Error messages about a preempted MPLS or GMPLS traffic engineering label switched path. It documents existing behavior to improve interoperability. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When a network path gets bumped to make room for a more important one, the routers send out error notes. This document says what each router should do when it sends or receives one of those notes.

questions: what happens when an rsvp path is preempted
rsvp path error handling for lsp preemption
